description: Accepts or dismisses a currently active JavaScript dialog on a page. Use dialogId from an Input Action result or Page.dialogOpened when the dialog must be identified explicitly.

pageId.description: Page ID with the pending native dialog.

accept.description: True to accept the dialog, false to dismiss it.

userInput.description: Optional text for prompt dialogs when accepting.

dialogId.description: Dialog ID from the triggering Input Action result, or from the latest Page.dialogOpened event when multiple dialogs are pending.

purpose.description: Describe why the dialog should be accepted or dismissed, e.g., confirming submission or cancelling an unsafe prompt

pageId.description: Page ID containing the handled dialog.

inputProvided.description: Whether text input was supplied to a prompt dialog.

observation.description: Facts directly observed by the Action or returned by its declared result schema.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the handled dialog.

inputProvided.description: Whether text input was supplied to a prompt dialog.

data.description: Validated business result returned by the Action.

message.description: Concise public explanation for the failure code.

observation.description: Directly observed failure fact; it must not infer an unobserved browser side effect.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

details.description: Only fields listed by the public error definition detailFields are returned; private execution diagnostics are omitted.
